holder-quote: Talia Kallinad raised her sword and saluted the [General]. He just charged at her. She pivoted—
effect-quote: All the force of a charging [Knight] on horseback put into a fast blow. The huge [General]—who had hair like armor on his thick arms—stopped his rush.

holder-quote: [Flurry Strikes] followed by [Lance Thrust]. His last two close-combat Skills. It should kill that [Knight] and then all Vexil had to do was run—or play dead. Either way…
